title.en: RAF Fairford: No 10 Insists Base Is Safe After US Withdraws B-1 Bombers Over Iran Drone Threat
title.zh-TW: 美國撤走 B-1 轟炸機後，唐寧街（No 10）堅稱皇家空軍費爾福德基地（RAF Fairford）安全無虞

summary.en: Downing Street insisted RAF Fairford remains secure a day after the US Air Force suddenly withdrew about a dozen B-1 bombers from the Gloucestershire base. The Pentagon confirmed the redeployment to US home stations, with American officials citing a reported threat of an Iranian drone attack as a factor.
summary.zh-TW: 美國空軍突然從英格蘭格洛斯特郡的皇家空軍費爾福德基地撤走約 12 架 B-1 轟炸機、送回美國本土，唐寧街隔天堅稱基地仍安全。五角大廈證實這次調動，美方官員表示，針對基地的疑似伊朗無人機攻擊威脅是原因之一。

body.en:
What happened
The Pentagon confirmed on Sunday that the US Air Force had removed its B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England, sending them back to their home stations in the United States. About a dozen B-1s were withdrawn from the Gloucestershire base amid reported security concerns, and American officials said the move was driven in part by intelligence about a possible Iranian drone attack against the base. A day after the sudden redeployment, Downing Street insisted that RAF Fairford is secure, moving to calm public concern about the apparent vulnerability of one of the few British bases able to host US heavy bombers.

Why it matters
RAF Fairford is a key forward operating location for US bomber deployments in Europe, so the hurried exit signals that Washington is taking the threat picture seriously. The contrast between the visible withdrawal and London's reassurance raises questions about how exposed allied airbases are, and whether deterrence posture in the region is quietly shifting.

Sources agree / disagree
BBC World, Sky News UK and The Guardian UK News all report the same core facts: the Pentagon's Sunday confirmation, the roughly dozen B-1s involved, the Gloucestershire location, the possible Iranian drone threat cited by American officials, and Downing Street's insistence that the base remains safe. None of the three outlets disputes the basic sequence of events.

Still uncertain
Details of the intelligence behind the threat assessment have not been disclosed, and there is no public timeline for when — or whether — the bombers will return. It is also unclear whether additional protective measures were quietly put in place at Fairford after the withdrawal.

發生了什麼事

費爾福德是美軍轟炸機在歐洲前進部署的關鍵據點，如此倉促的撤離顯示華府對威脅情勢相當認真。看得見的撤軍與倫敦的保證形成對比，也讓人質疑盟軍空軍基地的暴露程度，以及區域嚇阻態勢是否正在悄悄改變。

title.en: Eight-O'Clock Drama Actor Flamed After Revealing Yunnan Ancestry on Livestream, Fires Back
title.zh-TW: 八點檔男星直播自揭「祖籍雲南」遭炎上　回嗆批評者可悲

summary.en: An eight-o'clock-drama actor revealed on a livestream that his ancestral home is Yunnan and was promptly flamed online, firing back that his critics are pathetic, EBC reports. The heat cluster also sweeps in other 'livestream confession' items, including Ye Ke confirming she gave birth and discussing her split with Huang Xiaoming, and Jing Boran clapping back at plastic-surgery rumors.
summary.zh-TW: 一名八點檔男星在直播中自揭「祖籍雲南」後遭網友炎上，他回嗆批評者「很可悲」，東森電視報導。同一個熱度群組還混入其他「直播自揭」話題，包括葉珂認了生完寶寶並自揭與黃曉明分手內幕，以及井柏然被疑割雙眼皮後在直播開砲反擊。

body.en:
What happened
An eight-o'clock-drama actor said on a livestream that his ancestral home is Yunnan, and the remark drew a wave of online criticism. EBC reports that the actor fired back, calling his critics pathetic. The clip circulated as part of a broader 'livestream confession' heat wave tracked across Taiwanese entertainment feeds.

Why it matters
Ancestry and identity remarks remain a flashpoint for Taiwanese entertainers, where a single livestream comment can trigger days of pile-on. The episode also shows how heat-driven clusters bundle several loosely related 'confession' stories — from a star kid's partner boasting about past adult-video earnings to Ye Ke confirming she gave birth and discussing her split with Huang Xiaoming, and Jing Boran pushing back against claims he had double-eyelid surgery.

Sources agree / disagree
EBC, via Google News and LINE TODAY, is the consistent source for the Yunnan-ancestry item itself. The surrounding items come from different outlets — Mirror Media on the 170-kg streamer's adult-video past, ETtoday on Ye Ke and Jing Boran — and belong to separate stories that the heat keyword pulled into one cluster. Snippets flag differing figures (170 vs 1) across these unrelated headlines.

Still uncertain
Feed snippets do not name the eight-o'clock-drama actor, and short descriptions can omit context, updates or corrections. Click through to the publisher pages for the latest full reporting.

title.en: Flávio Bolsonaro's Shock First-Round Win Puts Brazil's Presidency Within Reach
title.zh-TW: 弗拉維奧·博索納羅（Flávio Bolsonaro）首輪爆冷勝出　距巴西總統大位一步之遙

summary.en: Flávio Bolsonaro is in pole position to win Brazil's presidency after a far-right surge propelled the 45-year-old to a shock first-round victory over incumbent Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, with about 56.1 million votes. Progressive voters are left reeling, and Lula has three weeks to find the votes to stop Brazil's — and Latin America's — rightward shift.
summary.zh-TW: 極右翼浪潮把 45 歲的弗拉維奧·博索納羅推上巴西總統大選首輪爆冷勝出、得票約 5610 萬張，現居領先地位。進步派選民大受打擊，現任總統路易斯·伊納西奧·盧拉·達席爾瓦只剩三週時間找票，試圖擋下巴西乃至拉丁美洲的右轉。

body.en:
What happened
Flávio Bolsonaro, the 45-year-old rightwing candidate, is in pole position to win Brazil's presidential election after a far-right tsunami propelled him to a shock first-round victory over the incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The candidate received about 56.1 million votes, leaving progressive voters and Lula supporters reeling, according to The Guardian and The New York Times.

Why it matters
A Bolsonaro return to the presidency would mark a major boost for the right in Brazil and across Latin America, reversing the left's hold on the country's top office. Both outlets frame the first-round result as a shock, underscoring how far the numbers ran ahead of what progressives expected. With a runoff looming, the next three weeks will decide whether Lula can assemble the coalition needed to halt the region's rightward shift.

Sources agree / disagree
The Guardian World and NYT World tell the same story: Bolsonaro's first-round lead, the scale of the far-right surge, the shock for progressives, and the three-week runway before the decisive vote. No outlet disputes the result or the vote count reported.

Still uncertain
First-round leads do not always survive runoffs, and it remains to be seen whether Lula can consolidate anti-Bolsonaro voters in the three weeks ahead. Turnout dynamics and endorsements from eliminated candidates could still reshape the race.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
45 歲的右翼候選人弗拉維奧·博索納羅在極右翼浪潮推動下，於巴西總統大選首輪爆冷擊敗現任總統路易斯·伊納西奧·盧拉·達席爾瓦，取得約 5610 萬票，站上領先位置。衛報與紐約時報報導，進步派選民與盧拉支持者大受打擊。

為什麼重要
博索納羅若重返總統大位，將是巴西乃至整個拉丁美洲右翼勢力的一大推進，終結左派對該國最高權力的掌握。決選在即，未來三週將決定盧拉能否湊齊擋下區域右轉所需的票源聯盟。

來源異同
衛報與紐約時報說法一致：博索納羅首輪領先、極右浪潮的規模、進步派的震驚，以及決選前三週的衝刺期。兩家都沒有質疑選舉結果或報導的得票數。

仍不確定
首輪領先不保證決選獲勝，盧拉能否在三週內整合反博索納羅選票仍待觀察。投票率變化與被淘汰候選人的表態，都可能重塑選情。

title.en: Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei Announce Divorce, Ending 11-Year Marriage
title.zh-TW: 方志友、楊銘威宣布離婚　11年婚姻告終：永遠是家人

summary.en: Taiwanese actors Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei have confirmed their divorce, ending an 11-year marriage that began when Fang was 24 and pregnant. The pair said they "can't be lovers anymore" but will "always be family." Outlets agree on the split; the reasons remain private.
summary.zh-TW: 藝人方志友、楊銘威證實離婚，結束11年婚姻。兩人當年24歲奉子成婚，聲明表示「無法再做情人」，但「永遠是家人」。各媒體對離婚事實說法一致，詳細原因未公開。

body.en:
What happened
Taiwanese actors Fang Zhiyou and Yang Mingwei have announced their divorce, ending 11 years of marriage. The pair married young — Fang was 24 and pregnant at the time — and said in their joint statement that while they "can't be lovers anymore," they will "always be family." China Times reports the marriage has formally ended; Yahoo News notes Yang has since made his first public appearance, with his latest status drawing attention. Taiwan media have also revisited the couple's rumored "four major grudges" and a past episode in which Yang was said to mention divorce after drinking, with actress Alyssa Chia quoted describing him as acting "like a lord" at home — though neither party has confirmed these details.
Why it matters
The split lands amid a wave of high-profile Taiwan entertainment breakups filling local feeds, and the couple's carefully worded "family forever" framing has set the tone for coverage: outlets are treating the divorce as amicable unless new details emerge.
Sources agree / disagree
China Times, Yahoo News, EBC, LINE TODAY and NOWnews agree the marriage is over and cite the same joint statement, with the 11-year timeline consistent across outlets. Figures of 3 versus 11 years appearing in some headlines come from an unrelated story swept into the same news cluster (see below), not from disagreement about this divorce.
Still uncertain
The specific reasons for the split have not been disclosed. Note: this cluster also contains an unrelated divorce rumor about a different local male star — a "3-year marriage" infidelity story involving a recording studio — which should be treated as a separate story, not part of the Fang-Yang split.

title.en: Xue Shiling's Draft-Evasion Scandal Flips Fortunes With Ex-Da Mouth Bandmate Huaiqiu
title.zh-TW: 薛仕凌陷閃兵風波星運急轉　懷秋靠《角頭》瘋癲反派戲約暴增

summary.en: Xue Shiling, once the breakout star of the disbanded duo Da Mouth with three Golden Bell acting awards, now faces a draft-evasion scandal that has clouded his career. Meanwhile former bandmate Huaiqiu has flipped the script with a scene-stealing villain in the Gatao franchise, and acting offers are pouring in.
summary.zh-TW: 「大嘴巴」解散後轉戰戲劇圈、拿下 3 座金鐘演技獎的薛仕凌，如今深陷閃兵風波，演藝路一片茫然。同團出身的懷秋則靠《角頭》系列的瘋癲反派翻身，戲約不斷，兩人星運出現明顯消長。

body.en:
What happened
Xue Shiling is mired in a draft-evasion scandal that has thrown his acting career into uncertainty, ETtoday reports. A decade after the duo Da Mouth disbanded, Xue had been the first to break out in television drama, collecting three Golden Bell Awards — two for best actor and one for supporting actor. Now, with the scandal hanging over him, his future looks murky. In a striking reversal, his former bandmate Huaiqiu — who once admitted feeling anxious watching Xue pull ahead during his own low period — has turned his career around with an unhinged villain role in the Gatao franchise, and offers are now pouring in, according to Yahoo and Mirror Media.

Why it matters
The story captures how quickly fortunes reverse in Taiwan's entertainment industry: one scandal can stall a decorated career while a single breakout role resurrects another. It also revisits the long-simmering rivalry narrative between the two ex-bandmates, who have barely kept in touch since the group split.

Sources agree / disagree
ETtoday, Yahoo Taiwan Entertainment and Mirror Media all describe the same arc — Da Mouth's breakup ten years ago, Xue's three Golden Bells, the draft-evasion cloud over him now, and Huaiqiu's Gatao-fueled comeback with surging offers. No outlet disputes the basic facts.

Still uncertain
The legal and professional fallout of Xue's draft case is still unfolding, and feed snippets do not detail the case's status. Whether Huaiqiu's momentum lasts beyond the current Gatao wave remains to be seen.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
薛仕凌深陷閃兵風波，演藝前途一片茫然，ETtoday 報導。「大嘴巴」解散 10 年後，薛仕凌是最早在戲劇圈發光的一位，拿下 2 座金鐘男主角、1 座男配角共 3 座演技獎。如今風波纏身，星途未卜。形成強烈對比的是，同團出身的懷秋——當年看著薛仕凌超前時曾坦言「心裡有點急」——靠《角頭》系列的瘋癲反派翻身，據 Yahoo 與鏡週刊報導，各方邀約不斷。

為什麼重要
這個故事呈現台灣演藝圈星運翻轉的速度：一場風波足以讓得獎無數的生涯停擺，一個搶眼角色也能讓另一人起死回生。也讓兩人自解散後幾乎零聯絡、暗自較勁的同團情結再度被翻出來談。

來源異同
ETtoday、Yahoo 奇摩娛樂與鏡週刊描述的軌跡一致：大嘴巴 10 年前解散、薛仕凌 3 座金鐘、如今的閃兵陰霾，以及懷秋靠《角頭》翻身、戲約暴增。三家都沒有質疑基本事實。

仍不確定
薛仕凌閃兵案的法律與事業後續仍在發展，新聞片段未說明案件進度。懷秋這波氣勢能否延續到《角頭》熱潮之後，也有待觀察。

imageAlt.zh-TW: 相關封面圖：受以色列鐵穹頂啟發，保守黨提議耗資 100 億英鎊的“不列顛盾牌”

title.en: Conservatives Pledge £10bn 'Britannia Shield' Air Defence Inspired by Israel's Iron Dome
title.zh-TW: 保守黨提議百億英鎊「不列顛盾牌」（Britannia Shield）　師法以色列鐵穹

summary.en: Britain's Conservatives will unveil plans at their party conference on Tuesday for a £10bn 'Britannia Shield' air and missile defence system modelled on Israel's Iron Dome. Shadow defence secretary James Cartlidge will argue Britain must be ready, as NATO allies warn of Russian drone incursions.
summary.zh-TW: 英國保守黨將在週二的黨大會公布耗資 100 億英鎊的「不列顛盾牌」防空飛彈系統計畫，師法以色列鐵穹。影子國防大臣詹姆斯·卡特利奇將主張英國必須做好準備；背景是北約盟國警告俄羅斯無人機入侵。

body.en:
What happened
The Conservatives will announce plans to build a £10bn British air and missile defence system modelled on Israel's Iron Dome, to be christened 'Britannia Shield,' at the party's conference on Tuesday. Shadow defence secretary James Cartlidge will say Britain needs to be ready, pitching it as one of the UK's 'most significant military programmes since the cold war,' the BBC and The Guardian report.

Why it matters
The pledge lands as NATO allies warn of Russian drone incursions into allied airspace, making homeland air defence a live political issue. A £10bn commitment would be a generational bet on missile defence — and a clear dividing line with the government on defence spending.

Sources agree / disagree
BBC UK and The Guardian UK News report the same core details: the £10bn figure, the 'Britannia Shield' name, the Iron Dome inspiration, the Tuesday conference announcement, and Cartlidge as the messenger. Neither outlet disputes the plan's outline.

Still uncertain
This is an opposition pledge, not funded policy: costings, timelines and technical design have not been published, and feed snippets do not say how the party would pay for it. Whether voters — or the defence establishment — buy the Cold War comparison remains to be seen.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
保守黨將在週二的黨大會上宣布，打造耗資 100 億英鎊、師法以色列鐵穹的英國版防空飛彈系統，命名為「不列顛盾牌」。據 BBC 與衛報報導，影子國防大臣詹姆斯·卡特利奇將主張英國必須做好準備，並稱這是英國「冷戰以來最重要的軍事計畫之一」。

為什麼重要
這項承諾登場的時機，正值北約盟國警告俄羅斯無人機入侵盟國領空，本土防空成為熱門政治議題。100 億英鎊的投入是世代級的飛彈防禦賭注，也是在國防支出上與執政黨劃清界線。

來源異同
BBC 與衛報報導的核心細節一致：100 億英鎊金額、「不列顛盾牌」名稱、鐵穹啟發、週二黨大會宣布、卡特利奇擔任傳聲者。兩家都沒有質疑計畫輪廓。

仍不確定
這是在野黨的承諾，不是已編預算的政策：經費細算、時程與技術設計都還沒公布，新聞片段也沒說錢從哪裡來。選民與國防體系買不買「冷戰以來」這個類比，還有待觀察。

title.en: Trump's 'Super Intelligence' Rebrand Was a Loyalty Test for Tech Executives — and It Worked
title.zh-TW: 川普要把 AI 改名「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence）：科技大老闆的忠誠度測驗

summary.en: Donald Trump wants artificial intelligence rebranded as 'super intelligence' — or SI, the same initials used by Slovenian domains. Wired frames it as a loyalty test for tech executives, who gushed about AI for years yet meekly went along when Trump scrapped the term; the BBC notes the rebrand triggered 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian web addresses.
summary.zh-TW: 川普希望把人工智慧改名為「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence），縮寫 SI 恰好也是斯洛維尼亞網域的縮寫。《連線》雜誌把這解讀為對科技大老闆的忠誠度測驗：他們多年來對 AI 讚不絕口，川普一聲令下廢掉這個詞，他們也乖乖照辦；BBC 則指出改名引發斯洛維尼亞網址「前所未見」的需求潮。

body.en:
What happened
President Donald Trump wants AI to be called 'super intelligence' — or SI, the same initials used by Slovenian domains. For years, tech billionaires gushed obsessively about artificial intelligence, but they meekly went along when Trump canceled the term, Wired reports. The BBC adds an unexpected side effect: the rebrand has caused 'unprecedented' demand for Slovenian website names.

Why it matters
If it sticks, the episode says less about branding than about power: the industry's most powerful executives folded on the very term they built their fortunes on. And the Slovenian domain rush is a reminder of how a throwaway political whim can ripple into real markets overnight.

Sources agree / disagree
BBC Technology and Wired AI describe the same episode — Trump's 'super intelligence' push, the SI/Slovenia collision, and executive compliance — from different angles: the BBC on the domain-name frenzy, Wired on the loyalty-test framing. Neither disputes the basic facts.

Still uncertain
Feed snippets do not say whether 'super intelligence' will appear in any official policy or remain a rhetorical flourish, nor how long the Slovenian domain surge will last. It is also unclear whether any tech company plans to adopt the term in its own branding. Short descriptions can omit context, updates or corrections.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
川普總統希望把人工智慧改稱為「超級智慧」（Super Intelligence），縮寫 SI 恰好與斯洛維尼亞網域縮寫相同。據《連線》雜誌報導，多年來對 AI 讚不絕口的科技億萬富豪們，在川普廢掉這個詞時乖乖照辦。BBC 則補上一筆意外後續：改名引發了斯洛維尼亞網址「前所未見」的需求潮。

為什麼重要
如果這波改名真的定調，重點不在品牌，而在權力：產業中最有權勢的大老闆們，連自己發家致富的關鍵詞都拱手讓人。而斯洛維尼亞網域搶購潮提醒我們，政治人物一句隨口的話，一夜之間就能在真實市場掀起漣漪。

來源異同
BBC 科技版與《連線》AI 版描述的是同一事件——川普的「超級智慧」主張、SI 與斯洛維尼亞的撞名、大老闆們的配合——只是角度不同：BBC 聚焦網域搶購，《連線》聚焦忠誠度測驗。兩家都沒有質疑基本事實。

新聞片段未說明「超級智慧」會不會寫進任何官方政策，還是只停留在口頭上；斯洛維尼亞網域熱潮能持續多久也不明。各科技公司是否會在自家品牌採用這個詞，同樣未知。

summary.en: The Nvidia Shield TV just got a $100 price hike — seven years after launch. Wired notes the price of anything with memory is skyrocketing thanks to AI, and aging streaming devices are no exception. The increase lands as AI-driven demand keeps memory prices climbing across consumer electronics.

body.en:
What happened
The Nvidia Shield TV is seven years old — and it just got a $100 price increase. Wired reports that the price of anything with memory is skyrocketing thanks to AI, and aging streaming devices are no exception to the squeeze, as AI-driven demand keeps memory prices climbing.

Why it matters
The hike is a small but telling sign of how AI's appetite for memory is spilling over into consumer electronics. When even a seven-year-old streaming box gets more expensive, it suggests memory costs are climbing across the board, not just in data centers. That framing puts the Shield TV in a broader category of older gadgets now costing more because of AI-driven component demand. The device has remained popular with enthusiasts despite its age, which makes the timing of the increase notable.

Sources agree / disagree

title.en: Rural Data Centers in Line for Major Federal Tax Break Under One Big Beautiful Bill Act
title.zh-TW: 《一大美麗法案》（One Big Beautiful Bill Act）上路　偏鄉資料中心明年起享聯邦大減稅

summary.en: Data center projects in rural areas could be eligible for major federal tax benefits starting next year under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, Wired reports. Notably, some hyperscalers do not seem eager to take the free cash — a lukewarm reception that raises questions about what strings, if any, come attached.
summary.zh-TW: 《連線》雜誌報導，根據《一大美麗法案》，偏鄉地區的資料中心專案明年起可能有資格獲得聯邦大幅稅收優惠。耐人尋味的是，部分超大規模業者似乎對這筆「免費的錢」興趣缺缺，背後是否有附帶條件引發疑問。

body.en:
What happened
Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, data center projects in rural areas could be eligible for major federal tax benefits starting next year. But some hyperscalers do not seem eager to take the free cash, Wired reports — a surprising reaction to what looks like a straightforward subsidy.

Why it matters
The tax break is meant to steer AI infrastructure investment toward rural America, spreading the data-center boom beyond the usual hubs. If the biggest operators shrug at the incentive, it raises questions about whether the policy is designed in a way the industry actually wants — or whether the strings attached outweigh the savings. The design of the incentive will matter as much as its size.

Sources agree / disagree
This is currently a single-outlet item from Wired AI; corroboration may rise as other allow-listed sources pick up the story. There are no conflicting accounts to reconcile.

Still uncertain
The feed snippet does not detail which projects qualify, how large the benefits are, or why some hyperscalers are cool on the offer. It is also unclear whether smaller operators, as opposed to hyperscalers, will be the main beneficiaries. Whether the incentive moves any actual site-selection decisions will only become clear once the benefits take effect next year.
body.zh-TW:

為什麼重要
這項減稅原本要把 AI 基礎設施投資引向美國偏鄉，讓資料中心熱潮擴散到傳統重鎮之外。如果最大業者對誘因無感，就讓人質疑政策設計是否真對業者胃口——還是附帶條件抵銷了省下的稅金。

來源異同

title.en: MCP for Agent-to-Agent Communication Called the Riskiest Protocol You've Never Heard Of
title.zh-TW: 代理人間通訊的 MCP（Model Context Protocol）：你沒聽過的最危險協議

summary.en: The adoption of AI agents across millions of organizations is creating new openings for attackers to make agents take malicious actions — from exfiltrating database contents to leaking sensitive business and personal information. Ars Technica reports that in the past five months, Google and four other organizations have acknowledged vulnerabilities in MCP-based agent-to-agent communication.
summary.zh-TW: 數以百萬計的組織採用 AI 代理，讓攻擊者有了新機會，誘使代理執行惡意行動——從竊取資料庫內容到洩漏敏感的業務與個人資訊。Ars Technica 報導，過去五個月，Google 等五家組織已承認基於 MCP 的代理人間通訊存在漏洞。

body.en:
What happened
AI agents are now deployed across millions of organizations, and that scale is creating new opportunities for attackers to make them take malicious actions, such as exfiltrating database contents and sensitive business and personal information. Ars Technica reports that in the past five months, Google and four other organizations — with little in common except their use of AI agents — have acknowledged vulnerabilities that exploit one agent through MCP, the protocol increasingly used for agent-to-agent communication.

Why it matters
Agent-to-agent communication is becoming the connective tissue of enterprise AI, which makes a protocol-level weakness far more dangerous than a single-app bug: one compromised agent can become a stepping stone to others. The fact that five unrelated organizations hit the same class of problem in five months suggests the risk is structural, not incidental.

Sources agree / disagree
This is currently a single-outlet item from Ars Technica; corroboration may rise as other allow-listed sources pick up the story. There are no conflicting accounts to reconcile.

Still uncertain
The feed snippet cuts off before detailing the specific vulnerabilities, so the exact attack mechanics are not covered here. It is also unclear how many deployed agents are exposed or what mitigations the affected organizations have put in place. Verify details on the publisher page.
body.zh-TW:
發生了什麼事
AI 代理已部署在數以百萬計的組織中，這樣的規模讓攻擊者有了新機會，誘使代理執行惡意行動，例如竊取資料庫內容、敏感的業務與個人資訊。Ars Technica 報導，過去五個月，Google 等五家彼此幾無共通點、唯一的交集就是使用 AI 代理的組織，都已承認出現可經由 MCP（代理人間通訊的主流協議）利用一個代理攻擊另一個代理的漏洞。

為什麼重要

Why it matters
The case drew national attention because of Flynn's reality-TV past, but its core is a domestic-violence homicide and an attempted cover-up. The life-without-parole sentence closes the criminal case, though the family's ordeal — and the public's fascination with the 'American Idol' connection — will linger.

發生了什麼事
前音樂牧師、《美國偶像》參賽者凱萊布·弗林，週一因以行刑式手法謀殺妻子艾希莉，被判終身監禁不得假釋。弗林被判謀殺罪名成立，並曾試圖把罪行嫁禍給家中的入室竊盜。宣判時法官對他說：「你所展現的層層欺騙、操縱與殘忍，老實說令人難以理解。」據 CBS 的傑瑞卡·鄧肯（Jericka Duncan）報導，弗林在宣判時仍堅稱自己無辜。

為什麼重要
本案因弗林的實境節目過往受到全國關注，但核心是一起家暴殺人案與企圖掩蓋。終身監禁不得假釋為刑事案件畫下句點，但家屬的傷痛——以及大眾對「美國偶像」連結的獵奇——還會持續。

來源異同
滾石雜誌音樂版與 CBS 犯罪新聞報導的事實一致：終身監禁不得假釋、有罪判決、偽造的入室竊盜說法、法官引言，以及弗林持續喊冤。兩家都沒有質疑任何環節。

仍不確定
宣判為本案畫下句點，但新聞片段未提及是否會上訴。簡短描述也可能遺漏脈絡、更新或更正，細節請以媒體原文為準。

body.en:
What happened
Hayley Williams isn't backing down on her beliefs. The Paramore frontwoman had a blunt message for the Department of Homeland Security after she shouted 'F–k ICE' and 'Free Palestine' during a recent concert in Chula Vista, California — 'And May I Suggest…'. DHS responded to the singer's remarks through a statement to Fox News, Billboard and Rolling Stone report.

Why it matters
Pop stars wading into immigration politics is nothing new, but a direct back-and-forth between a chart-topping singer and a federal agency shows how concert stages have become political battlegrounds. Williams' refusal to soften the message signals she is willing to absorb the backlash. For DHS, answering through a Fox News statement rather than staying silent suggests the agency felt the remarks could not go unanswered.

Sources agree / disagree
Billboard and Rolling Stone Music report the same sequence: the Chula Vista concert remarks, the 'And May I Suggest…' follow-up aimed at DHS, and the agency's statement to Fox News. Neither outlet disputes the facts as reported.

Still uncertain
The feed snippet cuts off DHS's full statement, so the agency's complete response is not covered here. Whether the exchange escalates further — or fades after the news cycle — remains to be seen. Verify details on the publisher pages.

發生了什麼事
海莉·威廉斯沒有在信念上退縮。這位帕拉莫爾主唱在加州丘拉維斯塔演唱會上高喊「F–k ICE」與「自由巴勒斯坦」後，向美國國土安全部送上一句直球嗆聲：「我可以建議……」。據告示牌與滾石雜誌報導，國土安全部透過給福斯新聞的聲明回應了歌手的言論。

為什麼重要
流行歌手涉足移民政治不是新鮮事，但當紅歌手與聯邦機構直接交鋒，顯示演唱會舞台已成政治戰場。威廉斯拒絕軟化訊息，表明她願意承受反彈。

來源異同
告示牌與滾石雜誌音樂版報導的順序一致：丘拉維斯塔演唱會發言、針對國土安全部的「我可以建議……」後續、該部給福斯新聞的聲明。兩家都沒有質疑報導的事實。

仍不確定
新聞片段在國土安全部聲明處截斷，無法得知該部的完整回應。這場交鋒會升級還是隨新聞週期淡去，有待觀察。細節請以媒體原文為準。
